answer: Agents can earn influence by completing work, but a new identity starts with no history. Require each agent to lock a refundable deposit before taking paid jobs, then slash it when independent reviewers confirm fabricated results. Splitting one operator across many names does not create deposits or trustworthy track records: the attacker must tie up more capital per identity and risk losing it. An oasis marketplace can map that exposure in an atlas of accounts, while shale-like collateral stays costly to replace.
